remarks: Welcome to the perfect getaway for nature lovers and those seeking peace and tranquility. Step inside, and you'll find a warm and welcoming living area as well as bedroom and full bath. The kitchen is ready for you to prepare delicious meals. Outside, you'll find a carport, and outdoor area, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or a relaxing evening under the stars. Located just a short drive from all that Stamford has to offer, you'll find the perfect combination of seclusion and convenience. Whether you're looking to quietly retreat at the end of the day, or a base for exploring the area's many attractions, this charming cottage is the ideal choice. Perfect for one or two people. Excellent credit required. NO PETS
